verdict.rationale: Startup programs or accelerator, incubator and university partnerships are a fair axis for a law firm with a venture practice. The evidence shows general venture work (seed to IPO, about 70 deals a year), but nothing documents any program or partnership giving early startups structured access. The Regimbeau partnership is an IP-advisor collaboration, not a startup program, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm documents programs or partnerships with accelerators, incubators, or university ecosystems that give early startups structured access
